subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain open as the umbrella until both structured Control UI reply metadata and no-output fallback semantics land, or should maintainers split it fully to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 / https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561?
rationale: The remaining work is a product/runtime contract choice across UI, gateway protocol, agent context, and final delivery semantics, not a narrow source-only bug fix.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Keep this issue open until the reply metadata contract and final fallback delivery contract have landed or been explicitly split.

options.title: Split To Canonicals
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers confirm the reply metadata and no-output portions are fully owned by the narrower linked items.

options.title: Accept Markdown Reply Only
options.body: Treat the merged Control UI quote affordance as sufficient and leave structured reply identity out of Control UI for now.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the reply metadata contract and final fallback delivery contract have landed or been explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: The no-output half is already captured in a maintainer-authored final fallback contract issue, making this the clearest human decision anchor for split-or-keep scope.
